settings.title: Choose your water
settings.text: Pick your bottles and add a cooler if you need one. Complete your first order online.

settings.title: We confirm your route
settings.text: A Blue Star team member calls to confirm your address, delivery route, and first delivery date.

settings.title: We deliver & remind you
settings.text: We drop full bottles and take your empties. Each month we remind you the day before — just reply with your count.

settings.question: What's the bottle deposit?
settings.answer: Your first order includes a one-time $5.00 deposit per 5-gallon bottle. It's non-recurring as long as we swap your empties for full bottles, and it's refundable when you return your empties for good.

settings.question: How does monthly delivery work?
settings.answer: There are no auto-charges. Each month, the day before your route runs, we remind you by text, email, or phone call. Just reply with how many jugs you'd like and we'll bring them.

settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: Shipping is a flat $5.00 per delivery anywhere in our service area, no matter how many bottles you order.

settings.question: What's the difference between your waters?
settings.answer: Purified is Blue Star multi-stage water, clean and neutral. Natural is Grace Spring 100% natural spring water from a protected source. Alkaline is ALKAID 9.5 pH water with electrolytes. We also carry ALKAID alkaline in retail cases.

settings.question: Can I add a water cooler?
settings.answer: Buy any Avalon cooler ($180.00) and we add 5 free 5-gallon bottles and a bottle stand. Hot & cold, top or bottom loader, black or white.

settings.question: Do you deliver to my area?
settings.answer: We cover northern New Jersey — Bergen, Hudson, Passaic, Essex, Union, and Morris counties — plus all five NYC boroughs. Check your ZIP in the Delivery section above.

settings.question: What if my order arrives damaged or goes missing?
settings.answer: If your water arrives damaged, keep it — we'll send a replacement at no charge. If a delivery is stolen after drop-off, we'll issue a refund. Every delivery is photo-documented by our driver.

settings.question: Is Blue Star the same company as Grace Spring and ALKAID?
settings.answer: Yes — Blue Star, Grace Spring, and ALKAID are all from the same family water company in Paterson, NJ, serving New Jersey and New York since 2010.
